title: v5.3.8 — UI Overhaul: Back Button, Haptics & Polish
message: Back button and swipe-back navigation now works across all menus — settings, profile, leaderboard, shop, account, friends, and games all close properly when you swipe back or press the back button. Button press animation refined with research-backed 120ms timing and depressed inset shadow for a satisfying tactile feel. Haptic feedback added to every button tap (respects vibration toggle). Reduced motion support added for accessibility. Multiple design refinements based on Apple HIG, Material Design 3, and casino UI best practices.
